title: Precisely Late Enough
request: Keep every book whose days late is at least min_days, then sort the result by title. A book exactly on the boundary is still late enough.
objective: Filter rows with an inclusive predicate and sort the returned table.
hints: The sieve must include the boundary; the new cart must then be alphabetized.
where takes a column label and a predicate such as are.above_or_equal_to; sort returns another table.
Name the filtered table first, then sort that name by the requested label before delivering it.
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
n = random.randint(2, 8)
titles = make_array(*[random.choice(['Willow Manual', 'Amber Index', 'Cloud Diary', 'Moss Map']) + ' ' + str(i + 1) for i in range(n)])
days = make_array(*[random.randint(0, 12) for _ in range(n)])
shelf = Table().with_columns('title', titles, 'days', days)
min_days = random.randint(1, 10)
reference:
selected = shelf.where('days', are.above_or_equal_to(min_days))
ordered = selected.sort('title')
deliver(ordered)
